sanskrit: mā cid anyad vi śaṁsata sakhāyo mā riṣaṇyata | indram it stotā vṛṣaṇaṁ sacā sute muhur ukthā ca śaṁsata ||
english: Praise nothing else, O friends, and suffer no harm; be a praiser of Indra the bull, attending him at the pressing; again and again recite the lauds.

sanskrit: avakrakṣiṇaṁ vṛṣabhaṁ yathājuraṁ gāṁ na carṣaṇīsaham | vidveṣaṇaṁ saṁvananobhayaṁkaram maṁhiṣṭham ubhayāvinam ||
english: Like a bull who charges without bend, like an ox bearing the plough-yoke unwearied — he who dispels enmity, who wins all over, most munificent, the ally of both sides.

sanskrit: yac cid dhi tvā janā ime nānā havanta ūtaye | asmākam brahmedam indra bhūtu te 'hā viśvā ca vardhanam ||
english: Though these many peoples here invoke you diversely for help, let this our prayer, O Indra, be yours; may it be your strengthening through all the days.

sanskrit: vi tartūryante maghavan vipascito 'ryo vipo janānām | upa kramasva pururūpam ā bhara vājam nediṣṭham ūtaye ||
english: The inspired poets of the people, the bards of noble rank, spread their hymns to you, O Maghavan; advance upon the many-formed prize, bring the booty nearest to us for our aid.

sanskrit: mahe cana tvām adrivaḥ parā śulkāya deyām | na sahasrāya nāyutāya vajrivo na śatāya śatāmagha ||
english: Not even for a great price would I give you away, O wielder of the stone; not for a thousand, not for ten thousand, O thunderbolt-bearer, not for a hundred, O hundred-gifted one.

sanskrit: vasyām̐ indrāsi me pitur uta bhrātur abhuñjataḥ | mātā ca me chadayathaḥ samā vaso vasutvanāya rādhase ||
english: You are more to me than a father, than a brother who withholds; even my mother you and wealth gratify equally, O Vasu, for the sake of riches and bounty.

sanskrit: kveyatha kved asi purutrā cid dhi te manaḥ | alarṣi yudhma khajakṛt puraṁdara pra gāyatrā agāsiṣuḥ ||
english: Where are you, where do you go? Your mind wanders to many places. You are roused, O warrior, O destroyer of citadels — the Gāyatrā metres have gone forth.

sanskrit: prāsmai gāyatram arcata vāvātur yaḥ puraṁdaraḥ | yābhiḥ kāṇvasyopa barhir āsadaṁ yāsad vajrī bhinat puraḥ ||
english: Sing the Gāyatrā hymn to him, to him who has been quickened, the fort-destroyer; with these very metres may the thunderer come to sit upon the barhis of Kāṇva and may he smash the forts.

sanskrit: ye te santi daśagvinaḥ śatino ye sahasriṇaḥ | aśvāso ye te vṛṣaṇo raghudruvас tebhir nas tūyam ā gahi ||
english: Those steeds of yours that are in tens, those in hundreds, those in thousands, your bulls that run swiftly — with those come quickly to us.

sanskrit: ā tv adya sabardughāṁ huve gāyatravepasam | indraṁ dhenunm sudughām anyām iṣam urudhārām araṁkṛtam ||
english: Today I call forth for the Gāyatrā-trembling one the cow that yields savours; Indra is the good milch-cow, another, the food of broad stream, well fashioned.

sanskrit: yat tudat sūra etaśaṁ vaṅkū vātasya parṇinā | vahat kutsam ārjuneyaṁ śatakratuḥ tsarad gandharvam astṛtam ||
english: When the sun urged on Etaśa the fleet, winged like the wind, and the hundred-powered Indra conveyed Kutsa the son of Arjuna, tracking the undefeated Gandharva.

sanskrit: ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ | saṁdhātā saṁdhim maghavā purūvasus iṣkartā vihrutam punaḥ ||
english: He who even without prayer, before the collarbone could be pierced, is a joiner of joints, the Maghavan of many treasures, who repairs what has gone wrong.

sanskrit: mā bhūma niṣṭyā ivendra tvad araṇā iva | vanāni na prajahitāny adrivo duroṣāso amanmahi ||
english: May we not be like strangers, O Indra, remote from you, like abandoned forests; hard to satisfy, we, the stone-wielder's people, thought of wealth.

sanskrit: amanmahīd anāśavo 'nugrāsaś ca vṛtrahan | sakṛt su te mahatā śūra rādhasā anu stomam mudīmahi ||
english: We pondered, lacking swift horses and lacking fodder, O Vṛtra-slayer; but once with your great bounty, O hero, may we exult following your laud.

sanskrit: yadi stomam mama śravad asmākam indram indavaḥ | tiraḥ pavitraṁ sasṛvāṁsa āśavo mandantu tugryāvṛdhaḥ ||
english: If Indra would hearken to our laud, may the swift soma-drops that have flowed through the filter gladden him, him who grows mighty for Tugrya's descendants.

sanskrit: ā tv adya sadhastutiṁ vāvātuḥ sakhyur ā gahi | upastutir maghonām pra tvāvatv adhā te vaśmi suṣṭutim ||
english: Come today, urged on to this joint praise, come from your friend's side; may the praise of the bountiful ones go before you — for you I desire excellent laud.

sanskrit: sotā hi somam adribhir em enam apsu dhāvata | gavyā vastreva vāsayanta in naro nir dhukṣan vakṣaṇābhyaḥ ||
english: The pressers press the soma with stones; rinse it in the waters; men have clothed it as with a robe of cowhide and have drawn it from the flanks.

sanskrit: adha jmo adha vā divo bṛhato rocanād adhi | ayā vardhasva tanvā girā mamā jātā sukrato pṛṇa ||
english: Whether from the earth or from the broad sky's luminous realm above, grow great with your body through this hymn of mine; O wise one, fill what has been born.

sanskrit: indrāya su madintamaṁ somaṁ sotā vareṇyam | śakra eṇam pīpayad viśvayā dhiyā hinvānaṁ na vājayum ||
english: Press out for Indra the most intoxicating, most excellent soma; may the mighty one satiate himself with it, with every thought urging it like a racer for the prize.

sanskrit: mā tvā somasya galdayā sadā yācann ahaṁ girā | bhūrṇim mṛgaṁ na savaneṣu cukrudhaṁ ka īśānaṁ na yāciṣat ||
english: Let me not make you weary, O Indra, always begging with my songs over the soma; you who rage like a wild beast at the pressings — who would not beg the sovereign lord?

sanskrit: madeneṣitam madam ugram ugreṇa śavasā | viśveṣāṁ tarutāram madacyutam made hi ṣmā dadāti naḥ ||
english: The fierce rapture impelled by exhilaration, with fierce might, the overcomer of all, the one shaken from ecstasy — for in rapture he gives to us.

sanskrit: śevāre vāryā puru devo martāya dāśuṣe | sa sunvate ca stuvate ca rāsate viśvagūrto ariṣṭutaḥ ||
english: The god grants many desirable things to the mortal who has offered; he gives to the one who presses soma and to one who praises — praised by all, unharmed in renown.

sanskrit: endra yāhi matsva citreṇa deva rādhasā | saro na prāsy udaram sapītibhir ā somebhir uru sphiram ||
english: Come, O Indra, rejoice with your brilliant bounty, O god; fill your broad belly with the soma draughts together with your drinking companions, as a lake fills up.

sanskrit: ā tvā sahasram ā śataṁ yuktā rathe hiraṇyaye | brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye ||
english: A thousand, a hundred, harnessed to your golden chariot — let the long-maned bays yoked by prayer, O Indra, bring you here to drink the soma.

sanskrit: ā tvā rathe hiraṇyaye harī mayūraśepyā | śitipṛṣṭhā vahatām madhvo andhaso vivakṣaṇasya pītaye ||
english: On your golden chariot let the two tawny coursers with peacock-feathered tails and white backs convey you here for drinking the sweet exhilarating juice.

sanskrit: pibā tv asya girvaṇaḥ sutasya pūrvapā iva | pariṣkṛtasya rasina iyam āsutiś cārur madāya patyate ||
english: Drink of this, O hymn-lover, as the first drinker drinks the pressed soma; this offering of the refined, flavoursome juice is pleasant, fitted for exhilaration.

sanskrit: ya eko asti daṁsanā mahām̐ ugro abhi vrataiḥ | gamat sa śiprī na sa yoṣad ā gamad dhavaṁ na pari varjati ||
english: He who is alone in his wonder-deeds, great and fierce in his ordinances — may that broad-jawed one come; he will not stay behind; coming, he does not avoid the call.

sanskrit: tvam puraṁ cariṣṇvaṁ vadhaiḥ śuṣṇasya sam piṇak | tvam bhā anu caro adha dvitā yad indra havyo bhuvaḥ ||
english: You crushed with blows the roving fort of Śuṣṇa; you followed the light then, when you, O Indra, became one to be called upon in the second pressing also.

sanskrit: mama tvā sūra udite mama madhyaṁdine divaḥ | mama prапitve apiśarvare vasav ā stomāso avṛtsata ||
english: For me at sunrise, for me at midday of the sky, for me at the forward journey even in the dark season, O Vasu, have the lauds turned to you.

sanskrit: stuhi stuhīd ete ghā te maṁhiṣṭhāso maghonām | ninditāśvaḥ prапаthī paramajyā maghasya medhyātithe ||
english: Praise, do praise — these are your most bountiful ones, O you of the patrons' gifts: Ninditāśva, Prапаthī, Paramajyā, Magha — thus, O Medhyātithi.

sanskrit: ā yad aśvān vananvataḥ śraddhayāhaṁ rathe ruham | uta vāmasya vasunaś ciketati yo asti yādvaḥ paśuḥ ||
english: When in faith I mounted the chariot of Vananvat's horses, then is the wealth of the beautiful known to him who is the cattle-rich descendant of Yadu.

sanskrit: ya ṛjrā mahyam māmahe saha tvacā hiraṇyayā | eṣa viśvāny abhy astu saubhagāsaṅgasya svanadrāthaḥ ||
english: He who has bestowed upon me the bright bay horse together with golden trappings — may this chariot of Āsaṅga, resounding with good fortune, excel all things.

sanskrit: adha plāyogir ati dāsad anyān āsaṅgo agne daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ | adhokṣaṇo daśa mahyaṁ ruśanto naḻā iva saraso nir atiṣṭhan ||
english: Then Plāyogi surpassed others; Āsaṅga, O Agni, with ten thousands; ten bright bulls he gave me, gleaming, they stood forth from the pond as if from a lake.

sanskrit: anv asya sthūraṁ dadṛśe purastād anastha ūrur avarambamāṇaḥ | śaśvatī nāry abhicakṣyāha subhadram arya bhojanam bibharṣi ||
english: Before him is seen the broad thigh hanging down without bone; many a woman, beholding it, has said: 'You bear, O noble one, a splendid prize.'

sanskrit: idaṁ vaso sutam andhaḥ pibā supūrṇam udaram | anābhayin rarimā te ||
english: This pressed soma-juice, O Vasu — drink of it; fill full your belly; we have poured it out for you without fear.

sanskrit: nṛbhir dhūtaḥ suto aśnair avyo vāraiḥ paripūtaḥ | aśvo na nikto nadīṣu ||
english: Shaken by men, pressed with stones, filtered through the wool of sheep, purified — like a horse washed in the rivers.

sanskrit: taṁ te yavaṁ yathā gobhiḥ svādum akarma śrīṇantaḥ | indra tvāsmin sadhamāde ||
english: Like barley sweetened with milk, we have prepared it for you, O Indra, at this joint celebration.

sanskrit: indra it somapā eka indraḥ sutapā viśvāyuḥ | antar devān martyāṁś ca ||
english: Indra alone is the soma-drinker; Indra alone drinks the pressed juice, the all-living; he stands between gods and mortals.

sanskrit: na yaṁ śukro na durāśīr na tṛprā uruvyacasam | apaspṛṇvate suhārdam ||
english: Neither the bright one, nor the evil-wisher, nor the satisfied can turn away the wide-ranging one, the good-hearted Indra.

sanskrit: gobhir yad īm anye asman mṛgaṁ na vrā mṛgayante | abhitsaranti dhenubhiḥ ||
english: When others hunt after him as a herd hunts a wild beast — with cows away from us — they approach him with milch-cows.

sanskrit: traya indrasya somāḥ sutāsaḥ santu devasya | sve kṣaye sutapāvnaḥ ||
english: Let three soma-pressings of the god Indra be made, of him who drinks the pressed juice in his own dwelling.

sanskrit: trayaḥ kośāsaḥ ścotanti tisraś camvaḥ supūrṇāḥ | samāne adhi bhārman ||
english: Three vessels trickle down; the three bowls are well full, all upon the same support.

sanskrit: śucir asi puruniḥṣṭhāḥ kṣīrair madhyata āśīrtaḥ | dadhnā mandiṣṭhaḥ śūrasya ||
english: Pure you are, established in many places, mixed with milk in the middle, most exhilarating with curds — for the hero.

sanskrit: ime ta indra somās tīvrā asme sutāsaḥ | śukrā āśiraṁ yācante ||
english: These sharp soma-draughts, O Indra, pressed here among us, bright, call for the admixture of milk.

sanskrit: tām̐ āśiram puroḻāśam indremam somaṁ śrīṇīhi | revantaṁ hi tvā śṛṇomi ||
english: Mix the admixture and the cake offering; O Indra, prepare this soma — for I hear that you are wealthy.

sanskrit: hṛtsu pītāso yudhyante durmadāso na surāyām | ūdhar na nagnā jarante ||
english: Having drunk in their hearts they fight, like madmen with spirituous drink; they shout like a naked udder.

sanskrit: revām̐ id revatāḥ stotā syāt tvāvato maghоnaḥ | pred u harivaḥ śrutasya ||
english: The praiser of such a wealthy patron of prizes would himself be wealthy; go forward then, O bay-horsed one of renown.

sanskrit: ukthaṁ cana śasyamānam agor arir ā ciketa | na gāyatraṁ gīyamānam ||
english: Even a laud being recited — the unfriendly man of no gifts does not heed it; nor does he heed the Gāyatrā being sung.

sanskrit: mā na indra pīyatnave mā śardhate parā dāḥ | śikṣā śacīvaḥ śacībhiḥ ||
english: O Indra, do not hand us over to the mocker, do not hand us over to the arrogant one; give of your bounty, O powerful one, with your powers.

sanskrit: vayam u tvā tadidarthā indra tvāyantaḥ sakhāyaḥ | kaṇvā ukthebhir jarante ||
english: We indeed, for this very purpose, the Kāṇvas your friends wishing you near, laud you with hymns.

sanskrit: na ghem anyad ā papana vajrinn apaso naviṣṭau | taved u stomaṁ ciketa ||
english: Nothing else was gained in the newest works of the craftsman, O thunderer; it is your laud alone that has been desired.

sanskrit: icchanti devāḥ sunvantaṁ na svapnāya spṛhayanti | yanti pramādam atandrāḥ ||
english: The gods desire the one who presses soma; they do not long for sleep; the unwearied ones go to the feast of joy.

sanskrit: o ṣu pra yāhi vājebhir mā hṛṇīthā abhy asmān | mahām̐ iva yuvajāniḥ ||
english: Come forth now with prizes; do not be wrathful toward us, like a great man with a young wife.

sanskrit: mo ṣv adya durhaṇāvān sāyaṁ karad āre asmat | aśrīra iva jāmātā ||
english: Let not the ill-willed one do evil to us today at evening from afar, like an ill-favoured son-in-law.

sanskrit: vidmā hy asya vīrasya bhūridāvarīṁ sumatim | triṣu jātasya manāṁsi ||
english: For we know the bountiful good will and the three-fold-born mind of this heroic one.

sanskrit: ā tū ṣiñca kaṇvamantaṁ na ghā vidma śavasānāt | yaśastaraṁ śatamūteḥ ||
english: Pour in with the Kāṇvas present — for we know nothing more glorious than the hundred-aided one of might.

sanskrit: jyeṣṭhena sotar indrāya somaṁ vīrāya śakrāya | bharā piban naryāya ||
english: Press for Indra, O presser, the excellent soma, for the hero, for the mighty; bring it for the manly one to drink.

sanskrit: yo vediṣṭho avyathiṣv aśvāvantaṁ jaritṛbhyaḥ | vājaṁ stotṛbhyo gomantam ||
english: He who is most knowing in unmoved exploits, who gives to the singers the horse-rich prize, to the praisers the prize rich in cattle.

sanskrit: panyam-panyam it sotāra ā dhāvata madyāya | somaṁ vīrāya śūrāya ||
english: Wondrous, ever more wondrous, O pressers, hasten with the intoxicating soma for the hero, for the champion.

sanskrit: pātā vṛtrahā sutam ā ghā gaman nāre asmat | ni yamate śatamūtiḥ ||
english: The Vṛtra-slayer will drink the pressed soma; he will come, not distant from us; the hundred-aided one is restrained.

sanskrit: eha harī brahmayujā śagmā vakṣataḥ sakhāyam | gīrbhiḥ śrutaṁ girvaṇasam ||
english: Let the two bays yoked by prayer convey here the bountiful, the friend renowned through hymns, him who delights in songs.

sanskrit: svādavaḥ somā ā yāhi śrītāḥ somā ā yāhi | śipriṇṇ ṛṣīvaḥ śacīvo nāyam acchā sadhamādam ||
english: Sweet soma-draughts await you — come! Prepared soma-draughts await you — come! O broad-jawed, sage-like, mighty one, come here to this joint rejoicing.

sanskrit: stutaś ca yās tvā vardhanti mahe rādhase nṛmṇāya | indra kāriṇaṁ vṛdhantaḥ ||
english: And the praises that magnify you for great bounty and heroic might, O Indra — they magnify the doer of deeds.

sanskrit: giraś ca yās te girvāha ukthā ca tubhyaṁ tāni | satrā dadhire śavāṁsi ||
english: The songs and lauds directed to you, O hymn-bearer — those altogether have taken on powers.

sanskrit: eved eṣa tuvikūrmir vājām̐ eko vajrahastaḥ | sanād amṛkto dayate ||
english: Thus he, roaring aloud, the prize-winner, the sole thunderbolt-holder, from of old unscathed, distributes.

sanskrit: hantā vṛtraṁ dakṣiṇenendra purū puruhūtaḥ | mahān mahībhiḥ śacībhiḥ ||
english: Indra the Vṛtra-slayer with his right hand, the much-invoked, the much-praised — great through his great powers.

sanskrit: yasmin viśvāś carṣaṇaya uta cyautnā jrayāṁsi ca | anu ghen mandī maghоnaḥ ||
english: In him all peoples, and the bold deeds and the courses — they all indeed follow him, the gladdener, the generous.

sanskrit: eṣa etāni cakārendrо viśvā yo 'ti śṛṇve | vājadāvā maghonām ||
english: He, Indra, has done all these things, he who is heard beyond all — the prize-bestower for the bountiful.

sanskrit: prabhartā rathaṁ gavyantam apākāc cid yam avati | ino vasu sa hi voḻhā ||
english: The bearer-forward of the prize-seeking chariot, whom he protects even from afar — the lord of wealth, he is the carrier.

sanskrit: sanitā vipro arvаdbhir hantā vṛtraṁ nṛbhiḥ śūraḥ | satyo 'vitā vidhantam ||
english: The inspirer who gains with swift horses, the hero who slays Vṛtra with his allies, the true protector of the one who serves.

sanskrit: yajadhvainam priyamedhā indraṁ satrācā manasā | yo bhūt somaih satyamadvā ||
english: Worship him, O Priyamedhas, worship Indra with a gathered mind; may he who is the true drinker of soma be here with the soma-draughts.

sanskrit: gāthaśravasaṁ satpatiṁ śravaskāmam prutmānam | kaṇvāso gāta vājinam ||
english: Sing, O Kāṇvas, of him who has song-fame, the lord of truth, eager for renown, far-stretching — the prize-winner.

sanskrit: ya ṛte cid gāspadebhyo dāt sakhā nṛbhyaḥ śacīvān | ye asmin kāmam aśriyan ||
english: He who even without a word of praise gave cattle to his friends, the mighty companion of men — those who have leaned their desire upon him.

sanskrit: itthā dhīvantam adrivaḥ kāṇvam medhyātithim | meṣo bhūto 'bhi yann ayaḥ ||
english: Thus, O stone-wielder, you went to the devout Kāṇva Medhyātithi, having become a ram, going towards him.

sanskrit: śikṣā vibhindo asmai catvāry ayutā dadat | aṣṭā paraḥ sahasrā ||
english: Instruct Vibhindhu to give four times ten thousand and eight thousand besides.

sanskrit: uta su tye payovṛdhā māki raṇasya naptyā | janitvаnāya māmahe ||
english: And those two who grow with milk — may the Naptyas of Raṇa give no harm; we have invoked them for procreation.

sanskrit: pibā sutasya rasinoо matsvā na indra gomataḥ | āpir no bodhi sadhamādyo vṛdhe 'smām̐ avantu te dhiyaḥ ||
english: Drink of the pressed, flavoured juice; rejoice, O Indra, in the cow-rich one; be our companion in joint rejoicing for our increase; may your thoughts protect us.

sanskrit: bhūyāma te sumatau vājino vayam mā naḥ star abhimātaye | asmāñ citrābhir avatād abhiṣṭibhir ā naḥ sumneṣu yāmaya ||
english: May we be in your favour, prize-winners; let not our foe overthrow us; protect us, O you of brilliant might, with your aids; guide us into your blessings.

sanskrit: imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardhantu yā mama | pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipascito 'bhi stomair anūṣata ||
english: May these words of mine magnify you, O lord of many goods; the purifying, bright, inspired ones have sung around you with their lauds.

sanskrit: ayaṁ sahasraṁ ṛṣibhiḥ sahaskṛtaḥ samudra iva paprathe | satyaḥ so asya mahimā gṛṇe śavo yajñeṣu viprarājye ||
english: This one, made powerful with a thousand sages, has spread like the ocean; true is that greatness of his — I extol his might, which reigns supreme among the inspired at the sacrifices.

sanskrit: indram id devatātaya indram prayaty adhvare | indraṁ samīke vanino havāmaha indraṁ dhanasya sātaye ||
english: Indra truly at the assembly of gods, Indra at the proceeding sacrifice, Indra we call in the battle for the gaining of the forest's prize, Indra for the winning of wealth.

sanskrit: indro mahnā rodasī paprathaс chava indraḥ sūryam arocayat | indre ha viśvā bhuvanāni yemira indre suvānāsa indavaḥ ||
english: Indra spread out the two worlds with his greatness and might; Indra made the sun shine; in Indra all living beings have found their order; in Indra the pressed soma-drops.

sanskrit: abhi tvā pūrvapītaya indra stomebhir āyavaḥ | samīcīnāsa ṛbhavaḥ sam asvaran rudrā gṛṇanta pūrvyam ||
english: O Indra, the descendants of Āyu who drink first, the Ṛbhus together in accord have resounded with lauds; the Rudras praise the ancient one.

sanskrit: asyed indro vāvṛdhe vṛṣṇyaṁ śavo made sutasya viṣṇavi | adyā tam asya mahimānam āyavo 'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā ||
english: By this has Indra grown strong in his bull-like might through the rapture of the pressed soma with Viṣṇu; today the descendants of Āyu praise that greatness of his as of old.

sanskrit: tat tvā yāmi suvīryaṁ tad brahma pūrvacittaye | yenā yatibhyo bhṛgave dhane hite yena praskаṇvam āvitha ||
english: I seek from you that heroic strength, that prayer for the ancient design — with which you helped the Yatis and Bhṛgu when the prize was set, and with which you protected Praskaṇva.

sanskrit: yenā samudram asṛjo mahīr apas tad indra vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ | sadyaḥ so asya mahimā na saṁnaśe yaṁ kṣoṇīr anucakrade ||
english: With which you released the great waters into the ocean — that is your bull-like might, O Indra; that greatness of his is immediately unattainable, which the wide earth resounds with.

sanskrit: śagdhī na indra yat tvā rayiṁ yāmi suvīryam | śagdhi vājāya prathamaṁ siṣāsate śagdhi stomāya pūrvya ||
english: Be able for us, O Indra, since I seek from you the wealth and heroic strength; be able for the prize the first to be desired, be able for the laud, O ancient one.

sanskrit: śagdhī no asya yad dha paurom āvitha dhiya indra siṣāsataḥ | śagdhi yathā ruśamaṁ śyāvakaṁ kṛpam indra prāvaḥ svarṇaram ||
english: Be able for us — for you protected our ancient understanding, O Indra, of those who desire the prize; be able as you protected Ruśama, Śyāvaka, Kṛpa, O Indra, and Svarṇara.

sanskrit: kan navyo atasīnāṁ turo gṛṇīta martyaḥ | nahī nv asya mahimānam indriyaṁ svar gṛṇanta ānaśuḥ ||
english: What mortal now, swifter than linseed plants, shall praise him newly? For those who sing his Indra-might and glory have never truly attained to his greatness.

sanskrit: kad u stuvanta ṛtayanta devatā ṛṣiḥ ko vipra ohate | kadā havam maghavann indra sunvataḥ kad u stuvata ā gamaḥ ||
english: When do those who praise and order the divine, when does the seer, what inspired one, convey it? When, O Maghavan Indra, do you come to the call of the soma-presser? When do you come to the praiser?

sanskrit: ud u tye madhuttamā giraḥ stomāsa īrate | satrājito dhanasā akṣitotayo vājayanto rathā iva ||
english: Up go these most honey-sweet words, the lauds are set in motion — the prize-winners with imperishable aids, like chariots rushing for the prize.

sanskrit: kaṇvā iva bhṛgavaḥ sūryā iva viśvam id dhītam ānaśuḥ | indraṁ stomebhir mahayanta āyavaḥ priyamedhāso asvaran ||
english: Like the Kāṇvas, like the Bhṛgus, like the suns, they have all attained to what has been obtained; the Āyus, the Priyamedhas, magnifying Indra with their lauds, have sung out.

sanskrit: yukṣvā hi vṛtrahantama harī indra parāvataḥ | arvācīno maghavan somapītaya ugra ṛṣvebhir ā gahi ||
english: Yoke your two bays, O Indra, best Vṛtra-slayer, from afar; come hither, O Maghavan, for the soma-drinking, O fierce one, come with your two tall steeds.

sanskrit: ime hi te kāravo vāvaśur dhiyā viprāso medhasātaye | sa tvaṁ no maghavann indra girvaṇo veno na śṛṇudhī havam ||
english: For these Kāṇvas have cried out to you with prayer, the inspired ones for the winning of the sacrifice; so you, O Maghavan Indra, O hymn-lover, hear our call like a beloved one.

sanskrit: nir indra bṛhatībhyo vṛtraṁ dhanubhyo asphurah | nir arbudasya mṛgayasya māyino niḥ parvatasya gā ājaḥ ||
english: You drove Vṛtra out from the great bows, O Indra; you drove out the magic of Arbuda the beast; you drove out the cows from the mountain.

sanskrit: nir agnayo rurucur nir u sūryo niḥ soma indriyo rasaḥ | nir antarikṣād adhamo mahām ahiṁ kṛṣe tad indra pauṁsyam ||
english: The fires blazed forth, the sun blazed forth, the Indra-belonging essence of soma blazed forth; you pressed down the great serpent from the air — that, O Indra, is your manly power.

sanskrit: yam me dur indro marutaḥ pākasthāmā kauraуāṇaḥ | viśveṣāṁ tmanā śobhiṣṭham upeva divi dhāvamānam ||
english: Him whom Indra, the Maruts, Pākasthāman, Kaurayāṇa gave me — the most splendid of all in his own nature, running as if in heaven.

sanskrit: rohitam me pākasthāmā sudhuraṁ kakṣyaprām | adād rāyo vivodhanam ||
english: Pākasthāmā gave me Rohita, the well-yoked one filling the girth-strap — the awakener of riches.

sanskrit: yasmā anye daśa prati dhuraṁ vahanti vahnayaḥ | astaṁ vayo na tugryam ||
english: For whom ten other carriers bear back the yoke-shaft — like a bird to the home of Tugrya.

sanskrit: ātmā pitus tanūr vāsa ojodā abhyañjanam | turīyam id rohitasya pākasthāmānam bhojaṁ dātāram abravam ||
english: The self of the father, the body is the garment, the strength-giving ointment — Rohita's fourth one, Pākasthāman, the Bhoja, the giver, I have spoken of.

sanskrit: yad indra prāg apāg udaṅ nyag vā hūyase nṛbhiḥ | simā purū nṛṣūto asy ānave 'si praśardha turvaśe ||
english: Whether eastward, westward, northward or southward, O Indra, you are called by men — you are universally wide-spread, born for men, for the Ānavas you are abundant strength, for the Turvaśas.

sanskrit: yad vā rume ruśame śyāvake kṛpa indra mādayase sacā | kaṇvāsas tvā brahmabhiḥ stomavāhasas indrā yacchant у ā gahi ||
english: Whether with Rumā, Ruśama, Śyāvaka, or Kṛpa you rejoice together, O Indra — the Kāṇvas, the bearers of lauds, draw you with their prayers; O Indra come.

sanskrit: yathā gauro apā kṛtaṁ tṛṣyann ety averiṇam | āpitve naḥ prapitve tūyam ā gahi kaṇveṣu su sacā piba ||
english: As a wild bull thirsty makes its way to a waterless pool's edge, come quickly at our invitation, at the forward journey; among the Kāṇvas drink in full companionship.

sanskrit: mandantu tvā maghavann indrendo rādhodeyāya sunvate | āmuṣyā somam apibaś camū sutaṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ tad dadhiṣe sahaḥ ||
english: May the soma-drops gladden you, O Maghavan Indra, for the giving of bounty to the presser; from there you drank soma pressed in the bowl — that greatest strength you have taken on.

sanskrit: pra cakre sahasā saho babhañja manyum ojasā | viśve ta indra pṛtanāyavo yaho ni vṛkṣā iva yemire ||
english: He put forth strength with strength, broke anger with might; all your enemies, O young Indra, have bowed down like trees.

sanskrit: sahasreṇeva sacate yavīyudhā yas ta ānaḻ upastutim | putram prāvargaṁ kṛṇute suvīrye dāśnoti namaüktibhiḥ ||
english: Like one accompanied by a thousand, he who has brought near praise of you the youthful warrior — he makes a son surpassing, with heroic strength; he prospers with words of homage.

sanskrit: mā bhemа mā śramiṣmo ugrasya sakhye tava | mahat te vṛṣṇo abhicakṣyaṁ kṛtam paśyema turvaśaṁ yadum ||
english: Let us not fear, let us not toil, in your friendship, O fierce one; great and worthy of sight is your deed, O bull — may we see Turvaśa and Yadu.

sanskrit: savyām anu sphigyaṁ vāvase vṛṣā na dāno asya roṣati | madhvā sampṛktāḥ sāragheṇa dhenuvus tūyam ehi dravā piba ||
english: He roars following the left flank like a bull; the giver's gift does not wane; the milch-cows mixed with honey by the bees — come quickly, run, drink.

sanskrit: aśvī rathī surūpa id gomām̐ id indra te sakhā | śvātrabhaját vayasā sacate sadā candro yāti sabhām upa ||
english: Your friend, O Indra, is rich in horses, rich in chariots, well-formed, rich in cattle; he accompanies the feast of meat always; the moon-bright one goes to the assembly.

sanskrit: ṛśyo na tṛṣyann avapānam ā gahi pibā somaṁ vaśām̐ anu | nimeghаmāno maghavan dive-diva ojiṣṭhaṁ dadhiṣe sahaḥ ||
english: Come like a thirsty antelope to the watering-place; drink the soma following the wish; having drunk, O Maghavan, day by day you take on the strongest might.

sanskrit: adhvaryo drāvayā tvaṁ somam indraḥ pipāsati | upa nūnaṁ yuyuje vṛṣaṇā harī ā ca jagāma vṛtrahā ||
english: Make the soma flow, O Adhvaryu — Indra thirsts; now the two bull-strong bays have been yoked and the Vṛtra-slayer has come.

sanskrit: svayaṁ cit sa manyate dāśurir jano yatrā somasya tṛmpasi | idaṁ te annaṁ yujyaṁ samukṣitaṁ tasyehi pra dravā piba ||
english: Even the worshipping man himself reckons where you satisfy yourself with soma; this food of yours, fit companion, well sprinkled — come for it, run, drink.

sanskrit: ratheṣṭhāyādhvaryavaḥ somam indrāya sotana | adhi bradhnasyādhrayo vi cakṣate sunvanto dāśvadhvaram ||
english: O Adhvaryus, standing in the chariot, press the soma for Indra; those pressing for the offering-performing sacrifice look toward the bright one above.

sanskrit: upa bradhnaṁ vāvātā vṛṣaṇā harī indram apаsu vakṣataḥ | arvāñcaṁ tvā saptayo 'dhvaraśriyo vahantu savaned upa ||
english: Both eager bull-strong bays will convey Indra to the waters; may the seven steeds lovely at the rite convey you hither at the pressing.

sanskrit: pra pūṣaṇaṁ vṛṇīmahe yujyāya purūvasum | sa śakra śikṣa puruhūta no dhiyā tuje rāye vimoсana ||
english: We choose Pūṣan for alliance, the lord of many goods; O mighty Indra, much-invoked, give of your bounty for our thought, for the strength to win wealth, O liberator.

sanskrit: saṁ naḥ śiśīhi bhurijor iva kṣuraṁ rāsva rāyo vimoсana | tve tan naḥ suvedam usriyaṁ vasu yaṁ tvaṁ hinoṣi martyam ||
english: Sharpen us like a razor on a whetstone, O liberator of riches; give to us — in you is that wealth of the morning cow, easily found, which you impel toward mortal man.

sanskrit: vemi tvā pūṣann ṛñjase vemi stoтava āghṛṇe | na tasya vemy araṇaṁ hi tad vaso stuṣe pajrāya sāmne ||
english: I reach out to you, O Pūṣan, to straighten myself; I reach out to the praiser, O shining one; I do not reach for what is remote — for that, O Vasu, I praise the Sāman of the Pajras.

sanskrit: parā gāvo yavasaṁ kac cid āghṛṇe nityaṁ rekṇo amartya | asmākam pūṣann avitā śivo bhava maṁhiṣṭho vājasātaye ||
english: Cattle have gone somewhere to the pasture, O shining immortal of permanent treasure; O Pūṣan, be our protector, be favorable, most bountiful for the winning of the prize.

sanskrit: sthūraṁ rādhaḥ śatāśvaṁ kuruṅgasya diviṣṭiṣu | rājñas tveṣasya subhagasya rātiṣu turvaśeṣv amanmahi ||
english: Substantial bounty with a hundred horses at the heavenly attacks of Kuruṅga, in the gifts of the splendid, fortunate king — among the Turvaśas we have thought of it.

sanskrit: dhībhiḥ sātāni kāṇvasya vājinaḥ priyamedhair abhidyubhiḥ | ṣaṣṭiṁ sahasrānu nirmajām aje nir yūthāni gavām ṛṣiḥ ||
english: Through the thoughts of the prize-winning Kāṇva and the heaven-assailing Priyamedhas, the seer drove off sixty thousand impeccable ones, drove off herds of cattle.

sanskrit: vṛkṣāś cin me abhipitve arāraṇuḥ | gām bhajanta mehаnāśvam bhajanta mehanā ||
english: Even the trees have resounded at my approach; they allotted me cattle abundantly, they allotted me horses abundantly.

sanskrit: dūrād iheva yat saty aruṇapsur aśiśvitat | vi bhānuṁ viśvadhātanat ||
english: As if from afar, when truly the ruddy-hued one shone out, it spread its beam all across the universe.

sanskrit: nṛvad dasrā manoyujā rathena pṛthupājasā | sacethe aśvinoṣasam ||
english: O wonder-working Aśvins, you two accompany the Dawn with a manly, mind-yoked chariot of broad splendour.

sanskrit: yuvābhyāṁ vājinīvasū prati stomā adṛkṣata | vācaṁ dūto yatohiṣe ||
english: O Vājinīvasū Aśvins, the lauds have faced toward you two; I, the messenger, have readied speech.

sanskrit: purupriyā ṇa ūtaye purumаndrā purūvasū | stuṣe kaṇvāso aśvinā ||
english: We Kāṇvas praise the Aśvins, who are dear to many for our aid, who delight many, who have many goods.

sanskrit: maṁhiṣṭhā vājasātameṣayantā śubhas patī | gantārā dāśuṣo gṛham ||
english: Most bountiful, most prize-winning, urging onward, lords of beauty — you will come to the house of the devout one.

sanskrit: tā sudevāya dāśuṣe sumedhām avitāriṇīm | ghṛtair gavyūtim ukṣatam ||
english: For the god-devoted, devout one, sprinkle the cattle-pasture with good intelligence and irresistible help, with ghee.

sanskrit: ā naḥ stomam upa dravat tūyaṁ śyenebhir āśubhiḥ | yātam aśvebhir aśvinā ||
english: Let our laud come running swiftly with swift eagles; come, O Aśvins, with your horses.

sanskrit: yebhis tisraḥ parāvato divo viśvāni rocanā | trīm̐r aktūn paridīyathaḥ ||
english: With those with which you two circle around the three remote realms, all the luminous spaces of heaven, and the three watches of night.

sanskrit: uta no gomatīr iṣa uta sātīr aharvidā | vi pathaḥ sātaye sitam ||
english: And for us the cow-rich refreshments and the gifts — O you who know the day, loosen the bonds on the path to the winning.

sanskrit: ā no gomantam aśvinā suvīraṁ surathaṁ rayim | voḻham aśvāvatīr iṣaḥ ||
english: Bring to us, O Aśvins, wealth rich in cattle, rich in heroes, rich in good chariots — bring refreshments rich in horses.

sanskrit: vāvṛdhānā śubhas patī dasrā hiraṇyavartanī | pibataṁ somyam madhu ||
english: Grown great, lords of beauty, wondrous ones with golden paths — drink the soma-sweetness.

sanskrit: asmabhyaṁ vājinīvasū maghavadbhyaś ca saprathaḥ | chardis yantam adābhyam ||
english: O Vājinīvasū, to us and to the bountiful patrons of wide extent, bring shelter that cannot be deceived.

sanskrit: ni ṣu brahma janānāṁ yāviṣṭaṁ tūyam ā gatam | mo ṣv anyām̐ upāratam ||
english: Do settle down the prayer of the people, come swiftly with the youngest speed; do not pause at another place.

sanskrit: asya pibatam aśvinā yuvam madasya cāruṇaḥ | madhvo rātasya dhiṣṇyā ||
english: Drink of this, you two Aśvins, of this pleasant intoxication, O attentive ones, of the honey bestowed.

sanskrit: asme ā vahataṁ rayiṁ śatavantaṁ sahasriṇam | purukṣuṁ viśvadhāyasam ||
english: Bring to us the wealth of hundreds, of thousands, of great abundance, all-nourishing.

sanskrit: purutrā cid dhi vāṁ narā vihvayante manīṣiṇaḥ | vāghadbhir aśvinā gatam ||
english: In many places indeed the wise men, the praisers, call upon you two, O heroes; come, O Aśvins, with the singers.

sanskrit: janāso vṛktabarhiṣo haviṣmanto araṁkṛtaḥ | yuvāṁ havante aśvinā ||
english: The people who have strewn the sacred grass, who bear oblations, who are prepared — they invoke you two, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: asmākam adya vām ayaṁ stomo vāhiṣṭho antamaḥ | yuvābhyām bhūtv aśvinā ||
english: This laud of ours today is the most carrying and most intimate; may it be for you two, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: yo ha vāṁ madhuno dṛtir āhito rathacarṣaṇe | tataḥ pibatam aśvinā ||
english: The leather bag of honey placed upon the chariot-seat — from that drink, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: tena no vājinīvasū paśve tokāya śaṁ gave | vahatam pīvarīr iṣaḥ ||
english: With that, O Vājinīvasū, bring rich refreshments for our cattle, for our offspring, for our wellbeing, for our cow.

sanskrit: uta no divyā iṣa uta sindhūm̐r aharvidā | apa dvāreva varṣathaḥ ||
english: And the heavenly refreshments and the rivers — O you who know the day, you pour them down like opening a door.

sanskrit: kadā vāṁ taugryo vidat samudre jahito narā | yad vāṁ ratho vibhiṣ patāt ||
english: When did Tugra's son find you two, O heroes, abandoned in the ocean, when your chariot flew to pieces?

sanskrit: yuvaṁ kaṇvāya nāsatyā ṛpiriptāya harmye | śaśvad ūtīr daśasyathaḥ ||
english: You Nāsatyas honour again and again with aids Kāṇva, restored and settled in his house.

sanskrit: tābhir ā yātam ūtibhir navyasībhiḥ suśastibhiḥ | yad vāṁ vṛṣaṇvasū huve ||
english: Come with those newer, excellent aids when I call upon you two, O Vṛṣaṇvasū Aśvins.

sanskrit: yathā cit kaṇvam āvatam priyamedham upastutam | atriṁ siñjāram aśvinā ||
english: As you helped Kāṇva, Priyamedha who was nearby praised, Atri, Śiñjāra — so, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: yathota kṛtvye dhane 'ṁśuṁ goṣv agastyam | yathā vājeṣu sobharim ||
english: As in the contest for the prize you helped Aṁśu among cows, Agastya — as Sobhari in the races.

sanskrit: etāvad vāṁ vṛṣaṇvasū ato vā bhūyo aśvinā | gṛṇantaḥ sumnam īmahe ||
english: To this extent, O Vṛṣaṇvasū Aśvins, or even more — while praising we seek your favour.

sanskrit: rathaṁ hiraṇyavandhuraṁ hiraṇyābhīśum aśvinā | ā hi sthātho divispṛśam ||
english: O Aśvins, you have mounted the chariot with golden seat, with golden reins, sky-touching.

sanskrit: hiraṇyayī vāṁ rabhir īṣā akṣo hiraṇyayaḥ | ubhā cakrā hiraṇyayā ||
english: Your pole is golden, the shaft is golden, the axle is golden; both wheels are golden.

sanskrit: tena no vājinīvasū parāvataś cid ā gatam | upemāṁ suṣṭutim mama ||
english: With that, O Vājinīvasū, come to us from far away; come to this excellent praise of mine.

sanskrit: ā vahethe parākāt pūrvīr aśnantāv aśvinā | iṣo dāsīr amartyā ||
english: Bring from afar, O Aśvins, eating the many divine, immortal refreshments.

sanskrit: ā no dyumnair ā śravobhir ā rāyā yātam aśvinā | puruścandrā nāsatyā ||
english: Come to us, O Aśvins, with glory, with renown, with riches; O Nāsatyas, you of many splendours.

sanskrit: eha vāṁ pruṣitapsavo vayo vahantu parṇinaḥ | acchā svadhvaraṁ janam ||
english: Let the winged ones, the birds sprinkled with drops, convey you both here to the people whose rite is good.

sanskrit: rathaṁ vām anugāyasaṁ ya iṣā vartate saha | na cakram abhi bādhate ||
english: Your chariot that rolls with the refreshment singing along — the wheel does not obstruct it.

sanskrit: hiraṇyayena rathena dravatpāṇibhir aśvaiḥ | dhījavanā nāsatyā ||
english: With a golden chariot, with swift-footed horses — O Nāsatyas, swift in thought.

sanskrit: yuvaṁ mṛgaṁ jāgṛvāṁsaṁ svadatho vā vṛṣaṇvasū | tā naḥ pṛṅktam iṣā rayim ||
english: You two refresh the wakeful wild beast, O Vṛṣaṇvasū; mix refreshment and wealth for us.

sanskrit: tā me aśvinā sanīnāṁ vidyātaṁ navānām | yathā cic caidyaḥ kaśuḥ śataṁ uṣṭrānāṁ dadat sahasrā daśa gonām ||
english: May you two Aśvins know the new acquisitions of mine, as when Kaśu the Caidya gave a hundred camels and ten thousand cattle.

sanskrit: yo me hiraṇyasaṁdṛśo daśa rājno amaṁhata | adhaspadā ic caidyasya kṛṣṭayaś carmamnā abhito janāḥ ||
english: He who has given me ten gold-gleaming kings — the peoples around him, the subjects of the Caidya, pressed down to the ground, wrapped in hides on all sides.

sanskrit: mākir enā pathā gād yeneme yanti cedayaḥ | anyo net sūrir ohate bhūridāvattaro janaḥ ||
english: Let none travel this path along which the Cedis go; lest another patron of superior bounty be drawn away from the people.

sanskrit: mahām̐ indro ya ojasā parjanyo vṛṣṭimām̐ iva | stomair vatsasya vāvṛdhe ||
english: Great is Indra who through might, like Parjanya swelling with rain, has been magnified through the lauds of Vatsa.

sanskrit: prajām ṛtasya pipрataḥ pra yad bharanta vahnayaḥ | viprā ṛtasya vāhasā ||
english: When the bearers, the inspired ones, carry the offspring of the Ṛta forward with the carrying of the Ṛta, who nourish the offspring of the Ṛta.

sanskrit: kaṇvā indraṁ yad akrata stomair yajñasya sādhanam | jāmi bruvata āyudham ||
english: When the Kāṇvas fashioned Indra with their lauds as the accomplisher of the sacrifice, the kindred declared the weapon.

sanskrit: sam asya manyave viśo viśvā namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ | samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ ||
english: To his wrath all peoples, all clans, have bowed, as rivers to the ocean.

sanskrit: ojas tad asya titviṣa ubhe yat samavartayat | indraś carmeva rodasī ||
english: This might of his was blazing when he rolled both together — Indra rolled the two worlds like a hide.

sanskrit: vi cid vṛtrasya dodhato vajreṇa śataparvaṇā | śiro bibheda vṛṣṇinā ||
english: He split the head of the roaring Vṛtra with his hundred-jointed thunderbolt, with the bull-like weapon.

sanskrit: imā abhi pra ṇonumo vipām agreṣu dhītayaḥ | agneḥ śocir na didyutaḥ ||
english: These thoughts at the head of the streams of the inspired we have praised forward, shining like the blaze of Agni.

sanskrit: guhā satīr upa tmanā pra yac śocanta dhītayaḥ | kaṇvā ṛtasya dhārayā ||
english: When the thoughts that are in hiding blaze forth of their own accord, the Kāṇvas do so through the stream of the Ṛta.

sanskrit: pra tam indra naśīmahi rayiṁ gomantam aśvinam | pra brahma pūrvacittaye ||
english: May we attain to that, O Indra — the wealth rich in cattle, rich in horses; may we bring prayer forward for the ancient design.

sanskrit: aham id dhi pituṣ pari medhām ṛtasya jagrabha | ahaṁ sūrya ivājani ||
english: I indeed have grasped the wisdom of the Ṛta from the father; I was born like the sun.

sanskrit: aham pratnena manmanā giraḥ śumbhāmi kaṇvavat | yenendra śuṣmam id dadhe ||
english: With ancient thought I adorn the hymns as Kāṇva does — with which Indra took on his energy.

sanskrit: ye tvām indra na tuṣṭuvur ṛṣayo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ | mamed vardhasva suṣṭutaḥ ||
english: The seers who have not praised you, O Indra, and those who have praised you — grow great for me, O well-praised one.

sanskrit: yad asya manyur adhvanīd vi vṛtram parvaśo rujan | apaḥ samudram airayat ||
english: When his wrath surged forward, breaking Vṛtra joint by joint, he set the waters moving toward the ocean.

sanskrit: ni śuṣṇa indra dharṇasiṁ vajraṁ jaghantha dasyavi | vṛṣā hy ugra śṛṇviṣe ||
english: You struck down the bullying Śuṣṇa with the thunderbolt, O Indra, against the Dasyu; for you, O bull, O fierce one, are famed as such.

sanskrit: na dyāva indram ojasā nāntarikṣāṇi vajriṇam | na vivyacanta bhūmayaḥ ||
english: The heavens have not encompassed Indra in his might, nor the mid-spaces the thunderbolt-holder, nor the earths.

sanskrit: yas ta indra mahīr apaḥ stabdhūyamāna āśayat | ni tam padyāsu śiśnathaḥ ||
english: He who lay blocking your great waters, O Indra, as they were being held firm — you thrust him down with your feet.

sanskrit: ya ime rodasī mahī samīcī samajagrabīt | tamobhir indra taṁ guhaḥ ||
english: He who seized these two great worlds, both together — him, O Indra, you have hidden in darkness.

sanskrit: ya indra yatayas tvā bhṛgavo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ | mamed ugra śrudhī havam ||
english: O Indra, the Yatis who have praised you, the Bhṛgus who have praised you — O fierce one, hear my call for me.

sanskrit: imās ta indra pṛśnayo ghṛtaṁ duhata āśiram | enām ṛtasya pipyuṣīḥ ||
english: These spotted cows of yours, O Indra, milk out ghee and the admixture; these have swelled with the Ṛta.

sanskrit: yā indra prasvas tvāsā garbham acakriran | pari dharmeva sūryam ||
english: Those springs, O Indra, like your own, have made the embryo — surrounding him like ordinance does the sun.

sanskrit: tvām ic chavasas pate kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ | tvāṁ sutāsa indavaḥ ||
english: You alone, O lord of might, the Kāṇvas have magnified with laud; you the pressed soma-drops.

sanskrit: taved indra praṇītiṣūta praśastir adrivaḥ | yajño vitantasāyyaḥ ||
english: In your leadings, O Indra, O stone-wielder, is the proclamation; the sacrifice is one to be spread far.

sanskrit: ā na indra mahīm iṣam puraṁ na darṣi gomatīm | uta prajāṁ suvīryam ||
english: Bring to us, O Indra, the great refreshment; break through like a fort rich in cattle; and offspring and heroic strength.

sanskrit: uta tyad āśvaśvyaṁ yad indra nāhuṣīṣv ā | agre vikṣu pradīdayat ||
english: And that swiftness of horses, O Indra, which shone at the head of the Nahuṣa peoples.

sanskrit: abhi vrajaṁ na tatniṣe sūra upākacakṣasam | yad indra mṛḻayāsi naḥ ||
english: Like the sun you stretch out to the nearby-visible fold; when you, O Indra, show us favour.

sanskrit: yad aṅga taviṣīyasa indra prarājasi kṣitīḥ | mahām̐ apāra ojasā ||
english: When indeed you, being fierce, rule over the settlements, O Indra — great, boundless in might.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā haviṣmatīr viśa upa bruvata ūtaye | urujrayasam indubhiḥ ||
english: To you, of wide stride, the peoples bearing oblations call for aid with soma-drops.

sanskrit: upahvare girīṇāṁ saṁgathe ca nadīnām | dhiyā vipro ajāyata ||
english: In the curve of the mountains, at the confluence of the rivers, the inspired one was born through insight.

sanskrit: ataḥ samudram udvataś cikitvām̐ ava paśyati | yato vipāna ejati ||
english: From there he, perceiving, looks down upon the ocean on the slopes, from where the drinking of the inspired one surges.

sanskrit: ād it pratnasya retaso jyotiṣ paśyanti vāsaram | paro yad idhyate divā ||
english: From the ancient seed they see the daily light, when it is kindled above the sky.

sanskrit: kaṇvāsa indra te matiṁ viśve vardhanti pauṁsyam | uto śaviṣṭha vṛṣṇyam ||
english: The Kāṇvas, O Indra, all magnify your thought, your manly power, and your bull-like strength, O mightiest one.

sanskrit: imām ma indra suṣṭutiṁ juṣasva pra su mām ava | uta pra vardhayā matim ||
english: O Indra, be pleased with this excellent praise of mine; do protect me; and do increase my thought.

sanskrit: uta brahmaṇyā vayaṁ tubhyam pravṛddha vajrivaḥ | viprā atakṣma jīvase ||
english: And we, devoted to prayer, O grown-great thunderbolt-holder, inspired ones, have fashioned this for life.

sanskrit: abhi kaṇvā anūṣatāpo na pravatā yatīḥ | indraṁ vananvatī matiḥ ||
english: The Kāṇvas have sung toward Indra as waters rushing down a slope, the thought that eagerly desires him.

sanskrit: indram ukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ samudram iva sindhavaḥ | anuttamanyum ajaram ||
english: The lauds have magnified Indra as rivers magnify the ocean — him of indestructible wrath, him who does not age.

sanskrit: ā no yāhi parāvato haribhyāṁ haryatābhyām | imam indra sutam piba ||
english: Come to us from afar with your two tawny, desired bays; drink this pressed soma, O Indra.

sanskrit: tvām id vṛtrahantama janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | havante vājasātaye ||
english: You alone, O best Vṛtra-slayer, the peoples who have strewn the sacred grass invoke for the winning of the prize.

sanskrit: anu tvā rodasī ubhe cakraṁ na varty etaśam | anu suvānāsa indavaḥ ||
english: Both worlds follow you like a wheel rolling behind Etaśa; the pressed soma-drops follow you.

sanskrit: mandasvā su svarṇara utendra śaryaṇāvati | matsvā vivasvato matī ||
english: Rejoice well, O manly shining one, O Indra, at Śaryaṇāvat; be exhilarated with the thought of Vivasvat.

sanskrit: vāvṛdhāna upa dyavi vṛṣā vajry aroravīt | vṛtrahā somapātamaḥ ||
english: Having grown great in the sky, the bull, the thunderer roared aloud — the Vṛtra-slayer, the greatest soma-drinker.

sanskrit: ṛṣir hi pūrvajā asy eka īśāna ojasā | indra coṣkūyase vasu ||
english: For you are the first-born seer, alone sovereign through might, O Indra, you eagerly seek wealth.

sanskrit: asmākaṁ tvā sutām̐ upa vītapṛṣṭhā abhi prayaḥ | śataṁ vahantu harayaḥ ||
english: May a hundred tawny steeds, with white backs, drive toward our pressed soma, toward the offering.

sanskrit: imāṁ su pūrvyāṁ dhiyam madhor ghṛtasya pipyuṣīm | kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ ||
english: This ancient thought swollen with sweetness and ghee — the Kāṇvas have magnified it with laud.

sanskrit: indram id vimahīnām medhe vṛṇīta martyaḥ | indraṁ saniṣyur ūtaye ||
english: Of the great ones let a mortal choose Indra at the sacrifice; let one who would win choose Indra for his aid.

sanskrit: arvāñcaṁ tvā puruṣṭuta priyamedhastutā harī | somapeyāya vakṣataḥ ||
english: O much-praised one, the two bays praised by Priyamedha shall carry you hither for the soma-drinking.

sanskrit: śatam ahaṁ tirindire sahasram parśāv ā dade | rādhāṁsi yādvānām ||
english: From Tirindira I received a hundred, from Parśu a thousand — the bounties of the Yādavas.

sanskrit: trīṇi śatāny arvatāṁ sahasrā daśa gonām | daduṣ pajrāya sāmne ||
english: Three hundred horses and ten thousand cattle they gave to the Pajra singer.

sanskrit: ud ānaṭ kakuho divam uṣṭrāñ caturyujo dadat | śravasā yādvaṁ janam ||
english: Kakuha has reached up to heaven, giving camels harnessed four together, making the Yādava people renowned.

sanskrit: pra yad vas triṣṭubham iṣam maruto vipro akṣarat | vi parvateṣu rājatha ||
english: When, O Maruts, the inspired one let the Triṣṭubh impulse flow forth for you, you ruled throughout the mountains.

sanskrit: yad aṅga taviṣīyavo yāmaṁ śubhrā acidhvam | ni parvatā ahāsata ||
english: When, being fierce, O bright ones, you harnessed the course, the mountains bent down.

sanskrit: ud īrayanta vāyubhir vāśrāsaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ || dhukṣanta pipyuṣīm iṣam ||
english: The roaring sons of Pṛśni rose up with the winds, they milked out the swelling refreshment.

sanskrit: vapanti marutaḥ miham pra vepayanti parvatān | yad yāmaṁ yānti vāyubhiḥ ||
english: The Maruts scatter the mist, they shake the mountains when they travel the course with the winds.

sanskrit: ni yad yāmāya vo girir ni sindhavo vidharmaṇe | mahe śuṣmāya yemire ||
english: When for your march the mountain and the rivers have set themselves in order for the great burst of your energy.

sanskrit: yuṣmām̐ u naktam ūtaye yuṣmān divā havāmahe | yuṣmān prayaty adhvare ||
english: You we invoke for aid at night, you during the day, you at the proceeding sacrifice.

sanskrit: ud u tye aruṇapsavaś citrā yāmebhir īrate | vāśrā adhi ṣṇunā divaḥ ||
english: The ruddy-hued, brilliant ones are set in motion with their courses — the roaring ones upon the ridge of heaven.

sanskrit: sṛjanti raśmim ojasā panthāṁ sūryāya yātave | te bhānubhir vi tasthire ||
english: They release the ray with might, the path for the sun to travel; they have spread themselves out with their beams.

sanskrit: imam me maruto giram imaṁ stomam ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ | imam me vanatā havam ||
english: Hearken to this hymn of mine, O Maruts, to this laud, O Ṛbhukṣan; be pleased with this call of mine.

sanskrit: trīṇi sarāṁsi pṛśnayo duduhr vajriṇe madhu | utsaṁ kavandham udriṇam ||
english: The Pṛśnis milked three lakes of honey for the thunderbolt-holder — the barrel-shaped overflowing spring.

sanskrit: maruto yad dha vo divaḥ sumnāyanto havāmahe | ā tū na upa gantana ||
english: O Maruts, when we invoke you seeking favour from heaven, then do come to us.

sanskrit: yūyaṁ hi ṣṭhā sudānavo rudrā ṛbhukṣaṇo dame | uta pracetaso made ||
english: For you are good-givers, Rudras, in the house, O Ṛbhukṣans, and also wise ones in the exhilaration.

sanskrit: ā no rayim madacyutam purukṣuṁ viśvadhāyasam | iyartā maruto divaḥ ||
english: Set in motion for us from heaven, O Maruts, the wealth shaken with exhilaration, of great abundance, all-nourishing.

sanskrit: adhīva yad girīṇāṁ yāmaṁ śubhrā acidhvam | suvānair mandadhva indubhiḥ ||
english: When, as if over the mountains, you bright ones harnessed the course, be exhilarated with the pressed soma-drops.

sanskrit: etāvataś cid eṣāṁ sumnam bhikṣeta martyaḥ | adābhyasya manmabhiḥ ||
english: To this extent a mortal might beg the favour of these indestructible ones, with hymns.

sanskrit: ye drapsā iva rodasī dhamanty anu vṛṣṭibhiḥ | utsaṁ duhanto akṣitam ||
english: They who blow upon both worlds like drops following the rains, milking the inexhaustible spring.

sanskrit: ud u svānebhir īrata ud rathai r ud u vāyubhiḥ | ut stomaiḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ ||
english: They rose up with their roarings, up with their chariots, up with their winds; up with their lauds, the sons of Pṛśni.

sanskrit: yenāva turvaśaṁ yaduṁ yena kaṇvaṁ dhanaspṛtam | rāye su tasya dhīmahi ||
english: With which you helped Turvaśa and Yadu, with which you helped Kāṇva who wins prizes — may we meditate on that for wealth.

sanskrit: imā u vaḥ sudānavo ghṛtaṁ na pipyuṣīr iṣaḥ | vardhān kāṇvasya manmabhiḥ ||
english: These refreshments, O good-givers, swollen with ghee, have magnified the Kāṇva with their hymns.

sanskrit: kva nūnaṁ sudānavo madathā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | brahmā ko vaḥ saparyati ||
english: Where now, O good-givers, do you rejoice with those who have strewn the sacred grass? What brahmin worships you?

sanskrit: nahi ṣma yad dha vaḥ purā stomebhir vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | śardhām̐ ṛtasya jinvatha ||
english: For not before when, O Maruts of strewn sacred grass, with praises, have you quickened the troop through the Ṛta.

sanskrit: sam u tye mahatīr apaḥ saṁ kṣoṇī sam u sūryam | saṁ vajraṁ parvaśo dadhuḥ ||
english: They have brought together the great waters, brought together the two earths, brought together the sun; they placed the thunderbolt together joint by joint.

sanskrit: vi vṛtram parvaśo yayur vi parvatām̐ arājinaḥ | cacrāṇā vṛṣṇi pauṁsyam ||
english: They went through Vṛtra joint by joint, through the mountains without a king — acting out the bull-like manly power.

sanskrit: anu tritasya yudhyataḥ śuṣmam āvann uta kratum | anv indraṁ vṛtratūrye ||
english: They followed the energy and the will of Trita as he fought; they followed Indra in the Vṛtra-contest.

sanskrit: vidyuddhastā abhidyavaḥ śiprāḥ śīrṣan hiraṇyayīḥ | śubhrā vy añjata śriye ||
english: Lightning-handed, heaven-assailing, with golden helmets on their heads, the bright ones adorned themselves for beauty.

sanskrit: uśanā yat parāvata ukṣṇo randhram ayātana | dyaur na cakradad bhiyā ||
english: When Uśanas came from afar, you two reached the hole of the bulls; heaven resounded with fear.

sanskrit: ā no makhasya dāvane 'śvair hiraṇyapāṇibhiḥ | devāsa upa gantana ||
english: For the giving of the prize, O gods, come to us with golden-handed horses.

sanskrit: yad eṣāṁ pṛṣatī rathe praṣṭir vahati rohitaḥ | yānti śubhrā riṇann apaḥ ||
english: When the dappled mare, the fore-runner, the ruddy one, draws the chariot of these, the bright ones go loosing the waters.

sanskrit: suṣome śaryaṇāvaty ārjīke pastyāvati | yayur nicakrayā naraḥ ||
english: At Suṣoma, at Śaryaṇāvat, at Ārjīka, at Pastyāvat, the heroes went along with their wheels.

sanskrit: kadā gacchātha maruta itthā vipraṁ havamānam | māṛḍīkebhir nādhamānam ||
english: When will you come, O Maruts, here to the inspired one calling, to him seeking your grace in his need?

sanskrit: kad dha nūnaṁ kadhapriyo yad indram ajahātana | ko vaḥ sakhitva ohate ||
english: Where now, where-beloved one, have you abandoned Indra? Who draws your friendship away from him?

sanskrit: saho ṣu ṇo vajrahastaiḥ kaṇvāso agnim marudbhiḥ | stuṣe hiraṇyavāśībhiḥ ||
english: With strength among us — we Kāṇvas praise Agni with the Maruts of thunderbolt hands, with golden roarings.

sanskrit: o ṣu vṛṣṇaḥ prayajyūn ā navyase suvitāya | vavṛtyāṁ citravājān ||
english: I would turn the sacrifice-loving bulls toward a newer well-being, the ones of brilliant prize.

sanskrit: girayaś cin ni jihate parśānāso manyamānāḥ | parvatāś cin ni yemire ||
english: Even mountains submit and bow down, those who think themselves ribbed peaks; even the highlands bend themselves.

sanskrit: ākṣṇayāvāno vahant у antarikṣeṇa patataḥ | dhātāraḥ stuvate vayaḥ ||
english: They who move diagonally carry through the mid-air as they fly — givers of sustenance to the praiser.

sanskrit: agnir hi jāni pūrvyaś chando na sūro arciṣā | te bhānubhir vi tasthire ||
english: For Agni is the ancient knower; like the sun with its flame he is the metre; they have spread themselves out with their beams.

sanskrit: ā no viśvābhir ūtibhir aśvinā gacchatam yuvam | dasrā hiraṇyavartanī pibataṁ somyam madhu ||
english: Come to us with all your aids, you two Aśvins; O wondrous ones of golden path, drink the soma-sweetness.

sanskrit: ā nūnaṁ yātam aśvinā rathena sūryatvacā | bhujī hiraṇyapeśasā kavī gambhīracetasā ||
english: Come now, O Aśvins, with a chariot having the skin of the sun, O you who bend, of golden ornament, O poets, of deep understanding.

sanskrit: ā yātaṁ nahuṣas pary āntarikṣāt suvṛktibhiḥ | pibātho aśvinā madhu kaṇvānāṁ savane sutam ||
english: Come around from Nahuṣa, from the mid-air, with excellent lauds; drink, O Aśvins, the sweetness, the soma pressed at the pressing of the Kāṇvas.

sanskrit: ā no yātaṁ divas pary āntarikṣād adhapriyā | putraḥ kaṇvasya vām iha suṣāva somyam madhu ||
english: Come to us from heaven, from the mid-air, O you who love what is below; the son of Kāṇva has pressed here the soma-sweetness for you.

sanskrit: ā no yātam upaśruty aśvinā somapītaye | svāhā stomasya vardhanā pra kavī dhītibhir narā ||
english: Come to us within earshot, O Aśvins, for the soma-drinking; O svadhā, the magnifiers of the laud — the two poets go forward with their thoughts, O heroes.

sanskrit: yac cid dhi vām ura ṛṣayo juhūre 'vase narā | ā yātam aśvinā gatam upemāṁ suṣṭutim mama ||
english: For the seers who of old invoked you for aid, O heroes — come, O Aśvins, come; approach this excellent laud of mine.

sanskrit: divaś cid rocanād adhy ā no gantaṁ svarvidā | dhībhir vatsapracetasā stomebhir havanaśrutā ||
english: Come to us from above the luminous realm of heaven, O you who find the sun; O you of calf-like wisdom, heard in the invocation through the lauds.

sanskrit: kim anye pary āsate 'smat stomebhir aśvinā | putraḥ kaṇvasya vāṁ ṛṣir gīrbhir vatso avīvṛdhat ||
english: Why do others sit about us with lauds for the Aśvins? The son of Kāṇva, the seer Vatsa, has magnified you both with his songs.

sanskrit: ā vāṁ vipra ihāvase 'hvat stomebhir aśvinā | ariprā vṛtrahantamā tā no bhūtam mayobhuvā ||
english: The inspired one has called you both here with his lauds for aid, O Aśvins; you who are stainless, best Vṛtra-slayers — be our benefactors.

sanskrit: ā yad vāṁ yoṣaṇā ratham atiṣṭhad vājinīvasū | viśvāny aśvinā yuvam pra dhītāny agacchatam ||
english: When the maiden mounted your chariot, O Vājinīvasū, you two Aśvins went forward to all the thoughts.

sanskrit: ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathенā yātam aśvinā | vatso vāṁ madhumad vaco 'śaṁsīt kāvyaḥ kaviḥ ||
english: From there come with your thousandfold-adorned chariot, O Aśvins; Vatsa the poet-seer has declared the honey-sweet speech to you.

sanskrit: purumаndrā purūvasū manоtarā rayīṇām | stomam me aśvināv imam abhi vahnī anūṣātām ||
english: O you who greatly delight many, who have many goods, O you who carry thoughts of riches — may the two bearers, the Aśvins, sing toward this my laud.

sanskrit: ā no viśvāny aśvinā dhattaṁ rādhāṁsy ahrayā | kṛtaṁ na ṛtviyāvato mā no rīradhatam nide ||
english: Bestow on us all bounties, O Aśvins, without shame; do not let us who observe the seasons be put to shame, do not abandon us to blame.

sanskrit: yan nāsatyā parāvati yad vā stho adhy ambare | ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathena yātam aśvinā ||
english: Whether you two Nāsatyas are in the distance or dwell above in the air — from there come with your thousandfold-adorned chariot, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: yo vāṁ nāsatyāv ṛṣir gīrbhir vatso avīvṛdhat | tasmai sahasranirṇijam iṣaṁ dhattaṁ ghṛtascutam ||
english: The seer who has magnified you both, O Nāsatyas, with his songs — for him set the thousandfold-adorned refreshment dripping with ghee.

sanskrit: prāsmā ūrjaṁ ghṛtascutam aśvinā yacchatam yuvam | yo vāṁ sumnāya tuṣṭavad vasūyād dānunas patī ||
english: Give to him the strength dripping with ghee, you two Aśvins; he who has praised you for your favour, seeking goods, O lords of the giving stream.

sanskrit: ā no gantaṁ riśādase maṁ stomam purubhujā | kṛtaṁ naḥ suśriyo nare imā dātam abhiṣṭaye ||
english: Come to us, O consumer of enemies, to this laud — O you who enjoy many things; grant these to us for beauty, O heroes, give them for our conquest.

sanskrit: ā vāṁ viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ priyamedhā ahūṣata | rājantāv adhvarāṇām aśvinā yāmahūtiṣu ||
english: The Priyamedhas have called you both with all aids; O Aśvins, ruling over the rites, at the calls of the journey.

sanskrit: ā no gantam mayobhuvā aśvinā śambhuvā yuvam | yo vāṁ vipanyū dhītibhir gīrbhir vatso avīvṛdhat ||
english: Come to us as benefactors, O Aśvins, as you who bring well-being; Vatsa who admires you has magnified you with his thoughts and songs.

sanskrit: yābhiḥ kaṇvam medhātithim yābhir vaśaṁ daśavrajam | yābhir gośaryam āvataṁ tābhir no 'vatam narā ||
english: With those aids with which you helped Kāṇva Medhātithi, with which you helped Vaśa of ten herds, with which you helped Gośarya — with those help us, O heroes.

sanskrit: yābhir narā trasadasyum āvataṁ kṛtvye dhane | tābhiḥ ṣv asmām̐ aśvinā prāvatam vājasātaye ||
english: With those aids with which you, O heroes, helped Trasadasyu in the contest for the prize — with those help us well, O Aśvins, for the winning of the prize.

sanskrit: pra vāṁ stomāḥ suvṛktayo giro vardhantu aśvinā | purutrā vṛtrahantamā tā no bhūtam purusspṛhā ||
english: May the well-fashioned lauds, the hymns, magnify you both, O Aśvins; O best Vṛtra-slayers in many places — be those who are eagerly desired by many for us.

sanskrit: trīṇi padāny aśvinor āviḥ santi guhā paraḥ | kavī ṛtasya patmabhir arvāg jīvebhyas pari ||
english: Three steps of the Aśvins are manifest; beyond is the hidden; the two poets through the paths of the Ṛta — before the living beings on this side.

sanskrit: ā nūnam aśvinor ṛṣiḥ stomaṁ ciketa vāmayā | ā somam madhumattamaṁ gharmaṁ siñcād atharvaṇi ||
english: Now the seer has arranged the laud of the Aśvins with a beautiful melody; may he pour the most honey-sweet soma into the heated vessel of the Atharvans.

sanskrit: yad antarikṣe yad divi yat pañca mānu ṣām̐ anu | nṛmṇaṁ tad dhattam aśvinā ||
english: Whatever heroic power is in the mid-air, whatever is in heaven, whatever follows the five peoples — that bestow on us, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: ye vāṁ daṁsāṁsy aśvinā viprāsaḥ parimāmṛśuḥ | evet kāṇvasya bodhatam ||
english: The inspired ones who have touched the wonders of you two, O Aśvins — take heed of the Kāṇva's words just so.

sanskrit: ayaṁ vāṁ gharmo aśvinā stomena pari ṣicyate | ayaṁ somo madhuman vājinīvasū yena vṛtraṁ cikethathaḥ ||
english: This hot drink is poured around you both, O Aśvins, with the laud; this honey-sweet soma, O Vājinīvasū, with which you perceive the Vṛtra.

sanskrit: yad apsu yad vanaspatau yad oṣadhīṣu purudaṁsasā kṛtam | tena māviṣṭam aśvinā ||
english: What you have done in the waters, in the forest lord, in the plants, O you of many wonders — with that enter into me, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: yan nāsatyā bharaṇyatho yad vā deva bhiṣajyathaḥ | ayaṁ vāṁ vatso matibhir na vindhate haviṣmantaṁ hi gacchathaḥ ||
english: What you nourish, O Nāsatyas, or what you heal, O gods — this Vatsa does not find you through prayers, for you go to those who bear oblations.

sanskrit: ā nūnam aśvinor ṛṣiḥ stomaṁ ciketa vāmayā | ā somam madhumattamaṁ gharmaṁ siñcād atharvaṇi ||
english: Now the seer has arranged the laud of the Aśvins with a beautiful melody; may he pour the most honey-sweet soma into the heated vessel of the Atharvans.

sanskrit: ā nūnaṁ raguuvartan i rathaṁ tiṣṭhātho aśvinā | ā vāṁ stomā ime mama nabho na cucyavīrata ||
english: Mount now the swift-wheeled chariot, O Aśvins; these lauds of mine have stirred toward you like a cloud.

sanskrit: yad adya vāṁ nāsatyokthair ācucyuvīmahi | yad vā vāṇībhir aśvine vet kāṇvasya bodhatam ||
english: If today we have stirred you, O Nāsatyas, with lauds, or with songs, O Aśvins — take heed of the Kāṇva's words.

sanskrit: yad vāṁ kakṣīvām̐ uta yad vyaśva ṛṣir yad vāṁ dīrghatamā juhāva | pṛthī yad vāṁ vainyaḥ sādaneṣu evet ato aśvinā cetayethām ||
english: What Kakṣīvant invoked of you, what the seer Vyaśva invoked, what Dīrghatamas invoked — what Pṛthī son of Vena invoked in his seat — just so, from that, O Aśvins, take heed.

sanskrit: yātam chardiṣpā uta naḥ paraspā bhūtam jagatpā uta nas tanūpā | vartis tokāya tanayāya yātam ||
english: Come as shelter-protectors and as protectors from beyond; be protectors of the world and of our bodies; travel as a path for our offspring and progeny.

sanskrit: yad indreṇa sarathaṁ yātho aśvinā yad vā vāyunā bhavataḥ samokasā | yad ādityebhir ṛbhubhiḥ sajoṣasā yad vā viṣṇor vikramaṇeṣu tiṣṭhataḥ ||
english: When you two go with Indra in one chariot, O Aśvins, or when you two are with Vāyu as co-dwellers; when you are of like will with the Ādityas, the Ṛbhus; or when you stand in the strides of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: yad adyāśvināv ahaṁ huveya vājasātaye | yat pṛtsu turvaṇe sahas tac chreṣṭham aśvinor avaḥ ||
english: If today I were to invoke you two Aśvins for the winning of the prize, for strength in the overwhelming battles — that is the best aid of the Aśvins.

sanskrit: ā nūnaṁ yātam aśvinе māśavyāni vāṁ hitā | ime somāso adhi turvaśe yadāv ime kaṇveṣu vāṁ atha ||
english: Come now, O Aśvins; these offerings are prepared for you; these soma-draughts are here among the Turvaśas and Yadus, these among the Kāṇvas then for you.

sanskrit: yan nāsatyā parāke arvāke asti bheṣajam | tena nūnaṁ vimadāya pracetasā chardir vatsāya yacchatam ||
english: Whatever remedy exists far off or nearby, O Nāsatyas — with that, O wise ones, give shelter to Vimada and to Vatsa.

sanskrit: abhutsy u pra devyā sākaṁ vācāham aśvinoḥ | vy āvar devī ā matiṁ vi rātim martуebhyaḥ ||
english: The divine one has arisen; together with the speech of the gods I speak the Aśvins; the divine one has turned — the thought and the gift open out for mortals.

sanskrit: pra bodhayoṣo aśvinā pra devi sūnṛte mahi | pra yajñahotar ānuṣak pra madāya śravo bṛhat ||
english: Waken the Aśvins, O Dawn; waken, O great divine Sūnṛtā; waken the hotar of the sacrifice in succession; waken the great glory for exhilaration.

sanskrit: yad uṣo yāsi bhānunā saṁ sūryeṇa rocase | ā hāyam aśvino ratho vartir yāti nṛpāyyam ||
english: When you, O Dawn, go with your beam and shine together with the sun, then the chariot of the Aśvins turns in its course, worthy for men to drink.

sanskrit: yad āpītāso aṁśavo gāvo na duhra ūdhabhiḥ | yad vā vāṇīr anūṣata pra devayanto aśvinā ||
english: When the soma-stalks, having been drunk, yield as cows with their udders, or when the songs have resounded forward, O Aśvins, in the manner of those seeking the divine.

sanskrit: pra dyumnāya pra śavase pra nṛṣāhyāya śarmaṇe | pra dakṣāya pracetasā ||
english: Go forward for glory, go forward for might, go forward for the shelter that conquers men, go forward for skill — O wise Aśvins.

sanskrit: yan nūnaṁ dhībhir aśvinā pitur yonā niṣīdathaḥ | yad vā sumnebhir ukthyā ||
english: When now, O Aśvins, you two sit down with your thoughts in the father's seat, or with your favours worthy of laud.

sanskrit: yat stho dīrghaprasadmani yad vā do rocane divaḥ | yad vā samudre adhy ākṛte gṛhe 'ta ā yātam aśvinā ||
english: Whether you two are in the long dwelling place, or in the shining realm of heaven, or in the ocean in the fashioned house — from there come, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: yad vā yajñam manave sammimikṣathur evet kāṇvasya bodhatam | bṛhaspatiṁ viśvān devām̐ ahaṁ huva indrāviṣṇū aśvināv āśuheṣasā ||
english: As you two mingled well with Manu's sacrifice — just so take heed of the Kāṇva's words; I invoke Bṛhaspati, all the gods, Indra and Viṣṇu, and the Aśvins, O swift-rushing ones.

sanskrit: tyā nv aśvinā huve sudaṁsasā gṛbhe kṛtā | yayor asti pra ṇaḥ sakhyaṁ deveṣv adhy āpyam ||
english: These two Aśvins I now invoke, the wonderful deeds-doers, taken in grasp; whose friendship with us is foremost, attainable among the gods.

sanskrit: yayor adhi pra yajñā asūre santi sūrayaḥ | tā yajñasyādhvarasya pracetasā svadhābhir yā pibataḥ somyam madhu ||
english: Those in whose presence the sacrifices of the sun-like patrons are foremost — those two, O wise ones, drink through your own powers the soma-sweetness at the sacrifice and the rite.

sanskrit: yad adyāśvināv apāg yat prāk stho vājinīvasū | yad druhyavy anavi turvaśe yadau huve vām atha mā gatam ||
english: Whether today, O Aśvins, you are westward or eastward, O Vājinīvasū; whether among the Druhyus, the Anus, the Turvaśas, the Yadus — I call upon you; therefore come to me.

sanskrit: yad antarikṣe patathaḥ purubhujā yad veme rodasī anu | yad vā svadhābhir adhitiṣṭhatho ratham ata ā yātam aśvinā ||
english: Whether you two fly through the mid-air, O you who enjoy many things, or whether you weave along both worlds — or whether you mount the chariot with your own powers — from there come, O Aśvins.
